headline: Do not pay. This offer looks fake.
summary: The company's own site says it never asks for money. We could not confirm the recruiter.

claims.reason: Northgate's own page says it never asks candidates for money.

do_this: Email Northgate using the address on northgate.com.
Block the number and report it on cybercrime.gov.in.
ask_them: Can you email me from an @northgate.com address?
What is the job ID on the careers page?
